Thanks for the forward, Soojin — reviewed the matrix this morning. A few notes / asks:

- Proposed guardrail: hard floor at 85% of global median for early IC levels (L3-L4); soft floor for L5+. This prevents under-offering while preserving flexibility at senior levels.
- Locality premium: recommend automatic +5% if candidate resides in an officially high-cost city (Sydney, Singapore). This prevents losing local candidates to local employers.
- Role variance: Product managers in SG are ~7% above general median; recommend role-specific uplift table included in 'Product' worksheet.

Operational ask: if we implement the purchasing-power normalization, please include a visible 'normalization reason' field on offer emails so candidates see why figures differ from local public data. Transparency reduces negative renegotiation.

Finally, please include a short note for Talent Ops on how this affects on-target compensation for FY28 budgeting.

Grace
Sr. Dir., Talent Acquisition
